procedures.name: RADAR 1E
procedures.description: Climb on HDG 133° to 1 500 ft, then expect radar vectors to intercept filed enroute fix or navaid.
restrictions: 6.6% CG required until 5 000 ft due airspace restrictions only.
If unable to comply with flight restrictions, advise ATC for alternative.

procedures.name: RADAR 1W
procedures.description: Climb on HDG 313°, then expect radar vectors to intercept filed enroute fix or navaid. turning to filed fix/navaid and proceed filed route and altitude.
restrictions: 7.7% CG required until 5 000 ft due airspace restrictions only.
If unable to comply with flight restrictions, advise ATC for alternative.
